purpose: Estimates how close a ticket is to breaching its resolution target, from its priority and the time elapsed since it was opened.

properties._about: time_basis: every minute between opened and now counts (nights and weekends included).

agent.role: SLA analyst for an application management team
agent.engine: Plain rules in sla_risk.py. No model or credentials needed.

inputs.name: opened
inputs.description: When the ticket was opened, ISO 8601.

inputs.name: now
inputs.description: Evaluation time, ISO 8601. Default: the current time.

outputs.name: target_minutes
outputs.description: Resolution target: P1 240, P2 480, P3 1440, P4 4320 minutes.

outputs.name: elapsed_minutes
outputs.description: Calendar minutes since the ticket was opened.

outputs.name: minutes_left
outputs.description: Target minus elapsed; negative when breached.

outputs.name: risk
outputs.description: low, medium (half or less left), high (a quarter or less left) or breached.

requirements.runtime: Python 3.9 or later, standard library only

how_to_run.interface: One JSON object on standard input; one JSON object on standard output. Exit code 2 and a message on standard error for invalid input.
